assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias.
Diagnosis code I48.91 is associated with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Diagnosis code I49.9 is associated with other underlying cardiac arrhythmias.
Standard ambulatory monitoring has been insufficient for capturing the rhythm disturbances.
The service provides continuous real-time monitoring and immediate alerting for significant arrhythmic events during the patient's daily activities.
